requirements.rule: LEAVE, STABILIMENTI BALNEARI (Art. 114 cc.2 and 4): 108 hours a year and 38 more hours after two years for the new hires, instead of 104 and 36; the seasonal contracts of Artt. 89-90 keep the whole reduction. The engine accrues the hours of the generalità.
requirements.remediation: Add employer and contract facts for the balneari and the seasonal contracts.

requirements.rule: BALNEARI AND ALBERGHI DIURNI (artt. 245, 250, 266 of the text of 8 February 2018): for an employer of the sub-sector stabilimenti_balneari or alberghi_diurni (EmployerProfile.subsector) the sickness pays the whole pay for the three days of carenza and 28% of the pay from the employer over the INPS indemnity (work_rules.subsector_rules); the non impiegati of the balneari have the hourly divisor 190 of the 44-hour week. The 44-hour week reaches the engine through the divisor alone: the caller states the overtime hours (OvertimeEvent). Not modelled: an INPS indemnity that INPS itself reduces (art. 250 c. 3: the employer does not make up the difference); the 28% is added to the rate the engine computes.
requirements.remediation: Let the caller state an INPS indemnity reduced by INPS and leave the difference unpaid.

requirements.rule: Art. 13 c. 10 of the renewal of 5 June 2024 (p. 7), with commi 5-8 of the CCNL 2018 (p. 29): the amounts of November 2027 (A and B 186, 1-3 158, 4-5 140, 6S-7 112) are parameters.equalisation_element. Approximated: the trigger, read from the second-level facts of 2026 where the text asks whether an agreement on the premio di risultato was defined by 31 October 2026 after a platform was presented; the eligibility of comma 5, read as in service in October 2027 with six months of service; the proportion to the days actually worked in 2026, counted in months of more than 15 days; the absorption of comma 8, which takes any individual or collective treatment granted after 1 June 2024 except the fixed amounts of collective agreements signed before 1 July 1993, the engine deducting only the individual elements. Not modelled: the welfare alternative of comma 11, the worker's choice to pay the amount to Fon.Te. (comma 12) and the crisis exemption of comma 13. Unlike the Federalberghi clause, art. 13 has no territorial floor.
requirements.remediation: State the comma 10 condition, the eligibility date and the days worked in 2026 as facts, take every treatment granted after 1 June 2024 (but the pre-1993 fixed amounts) into the absorption, and model commi 11, 12 and 13.

requirements.rule: SMALLER COMPANIES (Art. 162; accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024, pp. 4-6): the aziende minori dei pubblici esercizi and the stabilimenti balneari of the third and fourth category pay a reduced paga base, from 2.58 EUR less at level 7 to 5.68 EUR less at Qa, modelled as the base_salary_by_subsector aziende_minori (EmployerProfile.subsector). Not modelled: the lower contingenza of art. 163 c. 2 (up to 0.51 EUR), which the 2024 tables do not print.
requirements.remediation: Model the contingenza of art. 163 c. 2 if a current table prints it, then remove this note.
